Personality: Porphalios is a cold and intensely pragmatic archon. Lacking the fearless valor of traditional commanders, he conducts himself with extreme caution on the battlefield, preferring to minimize losses through tactical maneuvering rather than leading charges. Stingy and aloof in his personal dealings, he rarely grants favors and cares nothing for hollow fame. This detachment stems not from malice, but from a deeply ingrained instinct for self-preservation. As the head of the Serapides clan, he holds the survival of his house and the integrity of its property as his supreme creed. Prizing order and rules, he places strict demands on his subordinates and his children Aisos and Vamina; while this unsentimental style of management has earned him a reputation for ruthlessness, it has also ensured that Rhesos Castle maintains basic stability through turbulent years. A classic preserver of his patrimony, he precisely calculates every gain and loss amid a chaotic landscape.
Background: Porphalios hails from the noble Serapides clan of the Northern Empire, currently serving as clan leader from his seat at Rhesos Castle. His ancestors were frontier lords dispatched by the Senate to pioneer the northern wilderness, transforming marshes and forests into fertile wheat fields over generations of toil. When the Imperial civil war broke out, Porphalios pledged steadfast allegiance to Lucon, firmly convinced that only by upholding the authority of the Senate can propertied nobles like himself be protected from plunder by cash-strapped tyrants. As an archon of the Empire, he must not only handle complex administrative affairs, but also remain ever vigilant against raids from Battania and other neighboring powers. Though not renowned for martial prowess on the battlefield, his outstanding stewardship and tactical skill make him a key figure in securing the Northern Empire's rear. Having spent his life fighting to defend his family's fiefs and the traditional rights of the northern nobility, he stands as a staunch political ally in Lucon's camp.
